requirements.desc: Add plugin.repos and plugin.packages config support with repo ids, package ids, optional refs, and commit-pinned enabled package entries.
requirements.note: R1: loadConfig accepts plugin.repos and commit-pinned plugin.packages

requirements.desc: Implement plugin repo management and candidate discovery from checked-out plugin.json files for git URL and clean Git local path repo sources.
requirements.note: R2: plugin repo help exposes git URL and local path repository management

requirements.desc: Implement plugin install, list, enable, disable, update-all, and sync with safe checkout, validation, copying, token masking, and reproducible commits.
requirements.note: R3: plugin help exposes install list enable disable update and sync commands

requirements.desc: Reject unsafe plugin package structures, including invalid ids/files, contribution paths outside copied files, symlinks, .git content, package dependencies, and scripts.
requirements.note: R4: update-all rejects newly unsafe package contents before copying runtime files

requirements.desc: Make preset resolution, docs loaders, setup, and upgrade consume plugin preset contributions while retaining base as core builtin and .senti/presets/<key>/ as registry-backed project-local overlay.
requirements.note: R5: resolveChain uses enabled plugin preset contributions and project-local overlays

requirements.desc: Implement plugin registry static meta for preset/DataSource resolution, parent chains, override resolution, and template/data directive pre-validation.
requirements.note: R6: registry metadata validates DataSource static meta and bounded parent chains

requirements.desc: Move non-base official presets to senti-presets with plugin.json contributions and update core migration to install/enable them when existing config.type requires them.
requirements.note: R7: non-base official presets move out of core and into the official senti-presets artifact

requirements.desc: Move workflow command, skills, config schema/defaults, and flowIntegration support to senti-workflow-plugin while enabling the workflow plugin for every valid existing project during upgrade.
requirements.note: R8: workflow command skill and config contributions live in the official workflow plugin artifact

requirements.desc: Replace core workflow-specific top-level dispatch with generic plugin command dispatch that resolves core built-ins first and rejects overriding core commands.
requirements.note: R9: core dispatcher no longer hardcodes workflow and unavailable plugin commands fail non-zero
